newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco refinery lifts profits to $54.5 mln in 96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco refinery lifts profits to $54.5 mln in 96.

text.p: Morocco's main oil refinery Samir said in published results on Wednesday that it posted net profits of 506.7 million dirhams ($54.5 million) in 1996 compared with 423.3 million dirhams in 1995.
Turnover for second half of 1996 was four billion dirhams from 3.3 billion dirhams during same period the year before.
Total turnover for 1996 was 7.2 billion dirhams. There was no comparative figure for the whole of 1995.
The government floated 30 percent of the refinery on the Casablanca stock exchange in March last year.
The refinery is Morocco's biggest, supplying 75 percent of local demand for refined products. The government is planning a further privatisation of up to 50 percent of Samir's remaining equity.
Samir traded on the Moroccan bourse at 280 dirhams on Tuesday.
